title: Comparing KnowBe4 Pricing 2026 Plans and Costs
summary: KnowBe4 pricing structures vary by user count and feature access, helping organizations select the right security training tier for their budget.
body_markdown:
## Automate security training workflows with Activepieces


Activepieces eliminates the manual labor of security coordination by connecting disconnected simulation tools to your existing communication and HR platforms, drawing from a library of 750 integrations to bridge the gaps, which means your team can automate complex workflows without needing to build custom infrastructure.


While legacy platforms require an administrator to export CSVs and manually message non-compliant users, this automation engine uses a library of pre-built connectors to move data between apps based on specific event triggers.


### Syncing training completion to HRIS and Slack


The primary administrative burden in security awareness is keeping employee records accurate across disparate systems like HiBob and the security training portal.


Activepieces automates this by listening for a "Course Completed" webhook from the training provider and immediately updating the corresponding employee record in the HRIS, a process roughly 60% of which is supported by community-contributed integrations.


**The cost of these multi-step syncs remains predictable because the meter is the run, not the individual steps inside it.** Activepieces charges 1 credit per flow run regardless of how many steps are needed to update your records, which avoids the compounding costs found in Zapier's per-task or Make's per-module billing models.


### Automating the 'wall of shame' for overdue users


Activepieces replaces manual follow-up with scheduled flows that query the training API every Monday morning to identify users with "Overdue" status, offering unlimited flows on every plan to ensure no compliance check is skipped.


The system then filters these users by department and sends a consolidated list to the relevant manager or a public "Compliance" channel.


### Triggering remedial training based on phishing failures


Activepieces enables "Just-in-Time" learning by linking simulation outcomes to enrollment actions, a workflow that remains cost-effective as the platform allows up to 5 users on its $0 free forever plan, so small teams can implement professional training protocols without incurring any upfront subscription costs.


When a user clicks a link in a simulated phishing test, the platform catches that specific failure event and automatically enrolls that individual in a "Phishing 101" module.


**Regulated organizations like MoneyGram and FundingSocieties run Activepieces in production to maintain this level of control over sensitive security data.** The platform provides the same SSO, SCIM, custom RBAC, audit logs, and secret manager integration in its air-gapped edition as it does in the managed cloud, ensuring that high-security builds retain full functionality.
